value.name: meeting room is rearranged
value.description: The room has been deliberately reset overnight, with the boxes removed and legal pads, water, and croissants placed for the meeting.
evidence: The seven boxes from yesterday were gone — moved, Asha guessed, to the back parlor — and in their place was a single legal pad and a pen at each of four seats, and a pitcher of water and four glasses, and a small plate at the center of the table with four croissants on it, untouched.

value.name: Daniel rises to greet Asha
value.description: Daniel is already seated at the table and stands when Asha enters, signaling formal respect.
evidence: Daniel was already at the table. He stood up when she came in.

value.name: Rosa refuses to stand
value.description: Rosa remains seated and gives Asha a slight nod, a deliberate break from expected etiquette that shows resolve.
evidence: Rosa was sitting at the far end in the chair she had taken yesterday after Asha had asked her to sit. She did not stand. She looked at Asha and nodded once, slightly, and Asha understood that the nod was a piece of work — that Rosa had decided, sometime between four a.m. and now, that she would not stand up when the attorney came into the room, and that this small refusal of an old habit was, today, the largest thing she could do.

value.name: formal greetings are exchanged
value.description: Daniel and Rosa greet Asha, while Lucia remains silent and simply takes her seat.
evidence: Lucia said nothing, only took her seat across from Daniel.

value.name: Asha takes her seat and prepares documents
value.description: Asha sits at the head of the table, sets down her bag, and places a folder before her without opening it yet.
evidence: Asha sat down at the head of the table where she had sat yesterday. She put her bag on the floor beside her. She took out a slim folder and laid it on the table in front of her and did not yet open it.

value.name: Asha announces codicil filing
value.description: Asha begins the meeting by stating that the codicil has been filed with the Register of Wills and docketed.
evidence: "Before we begin," she said, "I want to say three things. The first is that the codicil was lodged this morning at eight forty-five with the Register of Wills, and the petition to admit it has been docketed."

value.name: Asha declares estate legally changed
value.description: Asha states that the estate is now legally altered, indicating a major shift in the case.
